title: Kontorchef til Analyse og Policy i Ministeriet for Samfundssikkerhed og beredskab
description:
Trives du i et udviklende lederjob på et højaktuelt område med stor bevågenhed og efterspørgsel efter konkrete politiske løsninger? Har du stærke analytiske kompetencer og kan du drive policy-udvikling, der styrker samfundssikkerheden?

Så har du nu mulighed for at blive en del af vores ledelsesgruppe i departementet med ansvar for en bred opgaveportefølje med fokus på udfoldelse af totalberedskabet og tværgående analyser af kritiske sårbarheder i samfundet.

Om Ministeriet for Samfundssikkerhed og Beredskab
Ministeriet for Samfundssikkerhed og Beredskab har i et tæt samarbejde med de ansvarlige sektorer ansvaret for at forebygge, modstå og håndtere større ulykker, kriser, katastrofer og andre hændelser, der udfordrer samfundets grundlæggende funktioner – uanset om det er cyberangreb, sabotage, spionage eller ekstreme vejrhændelser, som rammer. Ambitionen er at samtænke beredskab, krisestyring og robustgørelse på tværs af sektorer, så vores samfund står stærkere – både til hverdag og under kriser.

Ministeriet består af departementet og to faglige styrelser: Styrelsen for Samfundssikkerhed og Beredskabsstyrelsen.

Din rolle og dine opgaver
Som kontorchef for Analyse og Policy får du en central rolle i udfoldelsen af totalberedskabet. Du skal bidrage til at skabe overblik og finde løsninger, som understøtter det politiske niveau. Derudover får du en central rolle i at koordinere en fælles retning for arbejdet med at identificere og håndtere sårbarheder på tværs af sektorer.

Dine vigtigste opgaver bliver, at:

  • Videreudvikle kontorets fagområde og skabe rammerne for et stærkt fagligt miljø
  • Levere ministerbetjening af høj kvalitet og i rette tid
  • Omsætte politiske beslutninger til konkret handling med fokus på virkeligheden
  • Prioritere opgaver og ressourcer i en omskiftelig hverdag
  • Være en dygtig personaleleder, der skaber fremdrift, resultater og høj arbejdsglæde
  • Være faglig sparringspartner for medarbejdere og kollegaer
  • Bidrage til at udvikle departementet og vores samarbejdsrelationer.

Som kontorchef forventes du at have:

  • En relevant videregående uddannelse
  • En faglig stærk profil inden for samfundssikkerhed, sikkerhedsområdet, beredskab eller lignende
  • Skarpe strategiske og analytiske kompetencer
  • Stærke formidlingsevner og et veludviklet blik for politisk kommunikation
  • Evnen til at finde konkrete og virksomme politiske løsninger på komplekse problemstillinger
  • Erfaring med betjening af det politiske niveau i et ministerium, styrelse eller en anden politisk styret organisation
  • Succesfuld erfaring som leder eller et stærkt talent for ledelse

Vi lægger vægt på, at du er ambitiøs på egne og kontorets vegne samt en dygtig og inddragende leder. Som kontorchef i Ministeriet for Samfundssikkerhed og Beredskab bliver du en del af en stærk ledelsesgruppe, der prioriterer nærværende ledelse og fagligt stærke resultater.

Ansættelsesvilkår
Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår fastsættes på åremål og i henhold til ”Rammeaftalen om kontraktansættelse af chefer i staten” med en grundløn efter løngruppe 1. Hvis du i forvejen er tjenestemand, kan ansættelse som tjenestemand efter en konkret og individuel vurdering finde sted i lønramme 37. Ud over grundlønnen kommer et individuelt tillæg, åremålstillæg og pensionsordning.

Forventet tiltrædelse er 1. februar 2027 eller snarest muligt.

Ansættelsesområdet er Ministeriet for Samfundssikkerhed og Beredskab med tilhørende institutioner.

Tjenestestedet er Ministeriet for Samfundssikkerhed og Beredskab, departementet, Slotsholmsgade 12, 1218 København K.

Vil du vide mere
Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, kan du kontakte afdelingschef Karen Nilaus på 4090 9227.

Din ansøgning

Send din ansøgning, CV og eksamensbevis senest den 6. december 2026.

Du søger stillingen ved at klikke på ”Søg stillingen” i opslaget og udfylde ansøgningsformularen.

Vi forventer at gennemføre to samtalerunder. Første samtalerunde afholdes i uge 50, mens anden samtalerunde forventes afholdt i uge 51.

Ministeriet for Samfundssikkerhed og Beredskab opfordrer alle interesserede uanset race, hudfarve, religion eller tro, politisk anskuelse, seksuel orientering, kønsidentitet, kønsudtryk eller kønskarakteristika, alder, handicap eller national, social eller etnisk oprindelse til at søge.

title: Health Technician
description:
The Health Care Technician position at Edward Hines Jr. VA Hospital in Hines, IL is organizationally aligned with Nursing Service. Under the supervision of a Registered Nurse, this role encompasses both direct & indirect patient care activities, as well as related support functions. Individuals in this position are required to demonstrate strong powers of observation, perception, and judgment. Performs phlebotomy and all other specimen collection following the established policies. Performs 12 Lead EKG. Maintains the physical privacy and dignity of each patient while performing tasks. Obtains weights, height, blood pressure, pulse, respiration, blood glucose (finger stick), and records them appropriately in the medical record. Can distinguish significant variances in vital signs, pain, and finger sticks and reports them to the responsible RN. Responds to and assists during emergency treatment situations obtaining equipment as necessary and running errands as needed. Assists in emergency situations including but not limited to CPR as needed. Understands the appropriate body mechanics to safely move patients using a variety of lifts/transfer devices. Recognizes and reports potential safety hazards. Initiates emergency measures to protect patients. Maintains patient rooms and unit areas in a clean and orderly fashion. Participate in problem-solving activities/one on one care to maintain a safe environment. Documents in all forms of EHR as position requirements. Follows established Medical Center policies and procedures, rules and regulations, related to fire, disaster, security measures, computer security, and universal fluid precautions. Completes all required education requirements in a timely manner. Work Schedule: Monday - Friday, 7:30am - 4:00pm. Tour of Duty varies based on the needs of the service. In this role, you will design, develop, deploy, and scale control systems software on the CODESYS platform that runs the electrical and mechanical infrastructure of AWS data centers — the systems that keep our facilities powered, cooled, efficient, and reliable. Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and maintain mechanical control systems software on the CODESYS (IEC 61131-3) PLC platform for AWS data center infrastructure.

- Perform triage, root-cause analysis, and remediation of control system issues.
- Support first-of-kind builds — the first field deployment of a newly developed controller component — including occasional on-site travel to provide real-time break/fix support.
- Partner with our electrical and mechanical controls counterparts, Controls Design Engineering, Field Engineering, and other Data Center Engineering teams to develop the next generation of controllers.
- Document control system designs, configurations, and sequences of operation.
- Participate in design reviews and contribute to continuous improvement of controls development standards and tooling.
- Participate in an on-call rotation to provide escalation support for critical control system issues.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: FLIGHT SERVICES MANAGER
description:
THIS IS A NATIONAL GUARD TITLE 32 EXCEPTED SERVICE POSITION THAT REQUIRES MILITARY MEMBERSHIP. This National Guard position is for a FLIGHT SERVICES MANAGER, Position Description Number PDD1457000 and is part of the Mississippi National Guard.

As a FLIGHT SERVICES MANAGER, GS-2150-11, you will manage, direct and oversee the operation of all airfield activities and facilities under jurisdiction of the air base, and to coordinate as necessary with all applicable agencies, base flying activities and transient military aircrews and aircraft as well as civilian aircraft utilizing ANG facilities. Coordinates and maintains liaison with military, federal, and local agencies concerning airspace utilization, safety of flight, search and rescue operations, base contingency, and operational plans. MAJOR DUTIES: 1. Administers, plans, coordinates, and directs the activities of personnel performing flight services/airfield management support duties. These individuals may be on various types of employment status such as Air Technician, AGR, Special Training or on other approved manday orders. Performs the full scope of supervisory personnel functions including the assignment of duties, participates in the interviews and selection of employees, schedules and approves leave, ensures indoctrination of new employees, provides training, evaluates performance, initiates action to upgrade positions, and resolves disciplinary problems. Establishes shift schedules and assigns personnel based on workload to ensure adequate coverage of airfield/flight services operations. Supports and takes affirmative action with consideration of Equal Employment Opportunity in all aspects of personnel actions. Keeps employees informed of NGB goals, objectives, and policies, and informs management of employee input and concerns. 2. Plans, organizes, and coordinates airfield management activities during and after airfield operating hours. Identifies need for and coordinates all airfield construction and repair projects for both major and minor airfield improvement projects. Acts as the unit liaison with host airport authority to analyze impact of construction on operational flying activities. Evaluates airfield management activities to ensure compliance with established Air Force and FAA policies and directives. Advises unit commander(s) and staff on all airfield management related matters. Develops and applies Letters of Agreement, Host Tenant Support Agreements, Inter-service Support Agreements, Operational Plans, support of deploying units, and other support agreements as necessary with local and non-local agencies to support routine base flying activities as well as to respond to aircraft incidents; in-flight emergencies; search, rescue, and recovery operations; evacuations; and similar disasters, whether on or off base. 3. Develops and manages base flight line driving program to include training, certification, and remedial action when required. Establishes procedures for controlling privately owned vehicles on the flight line. --Directs the Operations Resource and Flight Management activities and oversees the custodial control and accountability for the AFORMS system. Analyzes and summarizes the reports from the data system to ensure maximum utilization of unit aircrew resources. Reviews operations resource management procedures and recommends changes to those procedures; inspects completed work; and evaluates employee performance. 4. Serves as the Operations Directorate's Resource Advisor (RA). Serves as primary point of contact for Responsibility Center Manager (RCM) and Comptroller personnel on all resource management matters affecting the unit. Develops initial budgetary requirements, programs available dollars, and identifies unfunded requirements. Monitors financial programs within Operations, consolidates initial requirements received from CCM, and validates unfunded requirements. Plans and anticipates allotment of workdays for the Operations Directorate and ensures that adequate O&M funds are available to support yearly deployments, exercises, and TDY. --When designated as the wing SORTS manager, collects and analyzes all available SORTS data to ensure accuracy of overall wing report. Prepares and presents formal SORTS briefings to Wing Commander and Staff, IG, MAJCOM, State Headquarters, and NGB. Publishes a formal training program for all unit SORTS monitors. 5. Reviews flight schedules, flight plans, local aircraft clearances, statistical mission data, and NOTAM files to ensure accuracy, completeness, and conformance with governing directives. Inspects publication files of air operations and aircraft flying directives for completeness and currency. Reviews Flight Information Publications (FLIP). --Supervises the procurement and maintenance of a complete stock level of publications, charts, maps, forms, office supplies, stereo flight plans, and other supplies and equipment required in the operation of the Branch. Ensures required maintenance of the FAA flight planning (Dial Labs) telecommunications equipment and other equipment such as NOTAM and weather receivers. 6. Performs other duties as assigned.

CONDITIONS OF EMPLOYMENT & NOTES: 1. Must be able to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance of the position. 2. This position is covered by the Domestic Violence Misdemeanor Amendment (30 Sep 96) of the Gun Control Act (Lautenberg Amendment) of 1968. An individual convicted of a qualifying crime of domestic violence may not perform the duties of this position. 3. Ability to establish effective professional working relationships with coworkers and customers, contributing to a cooperative working environment and successful accomplishment of the mission.4. May occasionally be required to work other than normal duty hours; overtime may be required. 5. The duties and responsibilities of your job may significantly impact the environment. You are responsible to maintain awareness of your environmental responsibilities as dictated by legal and regulatory requirements, your organization, and its changing mission. 6. Wear of the military uniform is MANDATORY. 7. This position is designated as Essential Personnel and may be subject to duty in preparation for, or in response to, a state emergency or disaster declaration. This designation will not exceed 14 calendar days per year unless otherwise approved in advance by the TAG 8. Participation in direct deposit is mandatory. 9. For positions requiring the operation of motor vehicles, candidates must have a valid state driver's license. 10. Irregular and/or overtime (compensatory) hours may be required to support operationalrequirements or contingencies or may be required to work hours outside of the normal duty day.

title: Game Analyst for Forge of Empires
description:
Hamburg
Forge of Empires is a long-running, data-rich Free-to-Play strategy game with millions of player decisions every day. Join us as a Game Analyst and turn LiveOps and monetization questions into clear, measurable actions - helping our team shape events, offers, and economies that players love and that sustainably grow revenue.

Your mission

  • LiveOps performance steering. You monitor and analyze event cycles, feature rollouts, and in-game promotions, and you proactively highlight opportunities and risks (e.g., pacing, difficulty spikes, churn signals).
  • Economy & progression analysis. You evaluate sinks/sources, resource inflation, and progression friction, and you advise on economy tuning to balance fun, fairness, and revenue.
  • Experimentation & uplift measurement. You co-own A/B tests for events, offers, and monetization features - defining hypotheses, success metrics, and guardrails, then quantifying incremental impact (uplift, cannibalization, long-term effects).
  • Monetization & full-funnel insights. You are confident working with both marketing and monetization KPIs - tracking the funnel from acquisition through offer performance - and translate findings into concrete areas of improvement that help the product reach its goals.
  • Dashboards & decision support. You build and maintain self-serve reporting for LiveOps and monetization, enabling fast decisions during event operations and post-mortems.
  • Cross-functional alignment. You collaborate with designers, product owners, and developers to improve tracking, ensure clean definitions of KPIs, and communicate results in a way that drives next actions.

Your skill set

  • Relevant experience. 2+ years in product/game analytics, in Free-to-Play with exposure to LiveOps and monetization topics (events, offers, economy, segmentation).
  • Strong SQL. You write performant queries on large event datasets, validate tracking logic, and are comfortable with joins, window functions, and cohort/funnel analysis.
  • Statistics you can apply. You understand experiment design, significance, bias pitfalls, and how to balance speed with rigor in a LiveOps environment.
  • Analytical tooling. Confident in Microsoft Excel for rapid analysis and Power BI for clear, reliable dashboards. You also bring working familiarity with AI assistants like Claude and have used Python in an analytical context before.
  • Monetization & F2P fluency. You know common F2P concepts (conversion, payer lifecycle, LTV, price elasticity, cannibalization) and follow the broader market - you play and observe live games, spot trends, and can connect them to product and monetization decisions.
  • Clear communication. You present insights as decisions: what happened, why it matters, what we should do next - tailored to mixed audiences.
  • Ownership & drive. You work in a self-driven way, ask the right questions before they're asked, and prioritize by impact. You thrive in a cadence-driven LiveOps setup and keep digging until you find the "so what?" behind the numbers.

Your power-ups

  • Career opportunities. Level up with excellent training and development opportunities, such as e-learning, hard- or soft-skill trainings or industry conferences.
  • Outstanding benefits. Get 28 vacation days, a sabbatical, mobile device, contribution to your public transport ticket, and more.
  • Flexible working hours. We offer trust-based working hours as well as active breaks - play table tennis with your team, work out in our gym or go to our rooftop terrace to get some fresh air.
  • Hybrid Working Model. We offer our colleagues the flexibility to choose between working from home and our modern offices in central Hamburg. With regular times planned together at the office during our Office Days, we keep up our unique InnoGames spirit!
  • Compensation & Fair Play. We have career models as well as market-competitive salary grids in place that ensure that we treat our employees fairly. For this regular-level position, the salary range is between € 55,200 and € 72,000 gross. Your seniority level (junior, regular, senior) will be evaluated during the interview process. The salary ranges for other seniority levels differ.
  • Team of specialists. Be part of a stable, growing, and award-winning global company. Meet your future colleagues in Business & Game Support and Creative & Product Management.
  • English first. Our company language is English, and we support all our employees with optional German lessons.
  • Team events. Participate in regular team events (e.g., wine tasting, cooking, paintball), barbecue together on our rooftop terrace, and enjoy regular company-get-togethers like the InnoConf or the Social Day.
InnoGames is one of the leading German developers and publishers of mobile and browser games and a certified Great Place to Work®. The Hamburg-based company was founded in 2007 and is now part of Modern Times Group (MTG). Together with about 350 employees from 40 nations, the company founders develop unique games that provide many years of fun for millions of players around the world. InnoGames is best known for Forge of Empires, Elvenar and Tribal Wars, but the company is continually expanding its now 10-game portfolio across platforms and genres. Most recently, InnoGames launched Heroes of History, a novel mix of city builder and hero collection RPG and Cozy Coast, a feel-good beach adventure with elaborate merge-2-gameplay and a captivating story.
Excited to start your journey with InnoGames and join our team as a Game Analyst? We look forward to receiving your application as well as your salary expectations and earliest possible start date through our online application form. Silja Bernecker would be happy to answer any questions you may have.

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Controls Design Execution
description:
Application deadline: Nov 28, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, electrical and mechanical engineers, as well as supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you interested in developing solutions that have big impact? Are you someone who likes to challenge the status quo and work on developing innovative product solutions? If you are a software engineer and looking for an exciting career in cloud infrastructure, come join a team that constantly seeks ways to build things better & faster for our customers.

AWS is looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to become part of a global Data Center Engineering team, responsible for the design, development, automation, and continuous innovation within our rapidly expanding and evolving data center footprint.

Our Controls Products & Services team takes full product ownership to design, develop, and deliver electrical and mechanical controls systems that programmatically scale compute capacity. As engineers at Amazon, we are responsible for achieving a world-class uptime for our customers. We seek new ways to enhance the reliability, scalability, and cost effectiveness of our engineering designs. As an engineer at Amazon, you have the ability to drive change and make a substantial impact in the systems our customers rely on.

At Amazon, teamwork is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. We work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As a software development engineer at Amazon you will be working with cross-functional groups throughout the global Data Center Engineering organization.

If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want you! Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.


Key job responsibilities
• Work in a cross-disciplinary setting with ability to influence and drive others.
• Work has deep and far reaching impact on overall product design/solutions.
• Advises peer engineers and management team.
• Make technical trade-offs between short-term project goals and long-term business needs.
• Develop common libraries and reusable modular components to accelerate build cycles.
• Simplify, optimize and accelerate the software development cycle for data center controls products.
• Leverage economy of scale through standardization and modularization of data center controls products.
• Provide technical subject matter expertise to peers, senior management, and partner teams.
• Develop business justification and narratives to promote new concepts and ideas.
• Lead key initiatives for the organization while demonstrating complete ownership.
• Work with global partners to deliver electrical and mechanical controls products.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

title: Actuarial Engineer
description:
Working Time: Full-Time

Hannover Re – as one of the world’s leading reinsurers, we provide coverage for the risks of yesterday, today and tomorrow. Our strength? Connecting Power: Within our global team of around 4,000 colleagues, we bring together knowledge, perspectives and a strong sense of responsibility. We rely on one another, challenge ourselves and continuously develop both our services and our products. Whether working with risk calculation models, developing digital tools or creating pragmatic solutions for our clients: here, you can contribute your expertise and actively shape what comes next. Sounds good? Get to know us as a reliable employer and find your place with us.

Let's connect: If you want to experience how things are done in the Finance Global Services, Operations & Reporting team at our headquarters in Hannover / Germany, join us on a permanent basis, commencing at the earliest possible date as an Actuarial Engineer. B ecome part of a team that understands existing systems, ensures their stable operation, and at the same time actively drives the digital evolution of planning and reporting.

You can look forward to

  • Collect, validate and implement requirements in the context of IFRS 17
  • Comprehensive onboarding into our TM1 / IBM Planning Analytics environment as well as the underlying actuarial and financial business processes
  • Enhance our planning and reporting data models and the associated data flows, including quality assurance and monitoring
  • Design and development of APIs, services, and data processing solutions based on C# / .NET
  • Automate data processing and reporting workflow
  • Collaborate closely with business functions such as Finance and Controlling

You come equipped with

  • Degree in Mathematics, Business Mathematics, or a comparable qualification
  • Very good knowledge of a higher programming language, e.g. C#, C++, Python
  • An enthusiasm for analysing complex calculation and data flows
  • Business fluent English and German
  • A collaborative mindset, a structured way of working and strong communication skills

You may not meet every requirement listed in the job description. However, if you bring strong expertise and identify with our values Responsibility, We-spirit and Drive, we look forward to receiving your application!

We offer you

  • Flexibility: A hybrid work model with flexible working hours and 30 days of annual leave
  • Work Abroad: Up to 30 days a year within the EU Member States, Iceland, Liechtenstein, Norway and Switzerland
  • Financial Benefits: Company pension scheme, employee shares at favourable conditions, vacation and Christmas allowances as well as financial participation in the company's success
  • Worry-free Relocation: Wrap-around (financial) support for your accommodation search and relocation to Hannover
  • Lifelong Learning: Innovative programme of further training, including e-learning, specialist seminars, soft skills training, language courses, opportunities for work shadowing in other departments
  • Digital Fitness: In short training sessions, we show you how to make your daily work more efficient and smarter using our AI tools – especially Microsoft Copilot
  • Healthy Work Environment: Ergonomic workstations, outstanding canteen with rich selection of regional dishes ranging from vegan to hearty made with organic ingredients
  • Corporate Fitness: Epassi membership (formerly Hansefit) across Germany or at Daily Fitness gym in Hannover (here also with access for family members)
  • Corporate Benefits: Discounts on products and services from well-known vendors (including travel, fashion and technology)
  • Individual Family Support: Company daycare facility and free, anonymous external counselling on personal, professional and psychological matters
  • Mobility: Ease of mobility with a free pass on local public transport (Deutschlandticket) and bicycle leasing (JobRad), free parking and electric charging stations for cars and bikes
  • Connecting Power: Together we enjoy parties, team events and internal networking activities

We are #somewhatdifferent – people with their own stories, experiences, and career paths. Everyone is welcome! Apply with just one click on the "Apply now"-button and become part of our diverse team! We'd love to hear about your skills and experiences. No need to upload a photo – it won't impact your application.

More on our work environment, your entry opportunities and development prospects can be found at www.hannover-re.com/en/career.

Joana Michel | Hannover Re | personnel@hannover-re.com

title: Government Information Specialist (Disclosure Technical Advisor) - NTE1 yr, MBE 2 yrs, MBMP
description:
WHAT IS PRIVACY (PRVCY)? A description of the business units can be found at: https://www.jobs.irs.gov/about/who/business-divisions Position(s) are to be filled in following area(s): PRVCY - Government Liaison-Disclosure and Safeguards This job (or announcement) is open to current permanent IRS competitive service employees in Privacy business units. REVIEW THE ADDITIONAL INFORMATION BELOW FOR FURTHER DETAILS

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level. If this vacancy includes more than one grade and you are selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform these duties and receive training to help you grow in this position. Serves as a senior advisor to the Disclosure Area Manager on operational, program, and case processing matters affecting the Area. Independently identifies and analyzes systemic barriers, emerging risks, and issues adversely affecting case processing, inventory management, timeliness, or program performance. Engages senior-level management and officials across IRS business units to elevate significant issues, resolve impediments, obtain commitments for corrective action, and facilitate timely resolution of matters affecting Disclosure operations. Keeps the Disclosure Area Manager apprised of significant issues, recommends appropriate courses of action, and follows matters through resolution. Area-wide operational analysis: Independently evaluates Area-wide inventory, aging, cycle time, workload distribution, staffing, quality, and other performance indicators to identify trends and recommend management interventions to the Disclosure Area Manager. Serves as an expert advisor who provides technical and administrative guidance on highly complex Disclosure/privacy issues, including memorandums issued, Internal Revenue Manuals (IRMs), Treasury Inspector General for Tax Administration (TIGTA) reports and technology. Also, collaborates on and implements confidentiality-related policies for nationwide application to both internal and external customers. Develops executive-level briefings, issue papers, risk assessments, talking points, and recommended courses of action for the Disclosure Area Manager on complex or sensitive operational and program matters. Cross-organizational problem resolution: Leads or coordinates resolution of issues requiring action by multiple Disclosure offices, IRS business units, or senior management organizations when those issues affect Area-wide case processing or program performance. STANDARD POSITION DESCRIPTIONS (SPD): PD26931 Visit the IRS SPD Library to access the position descriptions.

Design and build core search engine components, including indexing pipelines and retrieval/ranking systems at web scale. Develop streaming and batch data processing systems for search index construction under high load. Push hardware performance with low-level optimizations and systems tuning. Address multithreading, concurrency, and system-level optimization challenges. 3+ years hands-on systems programming experience. Knowledge of data processing systems (Kafka/Hadoop). Ownership of full project lifecycle, ensure system is built, deployed, operated, and scaled in production. Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures. Solid understanding of Linux internals (syscalls, networking, memory model, kernel tuning). Experience with high-load, distributed, and latency-sensitive services.

Automate administrative tasks using PowerShell and Bash. Maintain technical documentation and coordinate with third-party vendors. 5+ years' experience in Systems Administration or IT Infrastructure. title: Engineer - System Design
description:

The role involves self-driven, independent, and hands-on work in the areas of understanding stakeholder needs and expectations, legal research, stakeholder engagement, data analysis, investigation and root cause analysis, and risk management.

Key job responsibilities
• Workplace health and safety compliance and/or environmental compliance
• Defining, applying, and defending health and safety/environmental compliance requirements; operating in alignment with legal or regulatory requirements; and testing, remediating, and enhancing risk management controls. title: Customer Experience Executive
description:
Customer Experience Executive

The Customer Experience Executive is responsible for ensuring the best customer service is rendered to the residents and members.


About Core Collective:

Since our launch in 2018, Core Collective has propelled the professional growth of hundreds of fitness and wellness practitioners and business owners by providing a convenient and cost-effective plug-and-play solution at our three centres of excellence at Anson, Dempsey, and Katong.


Our purpose is to help our residents grow their businesses through comprehensive business support services and outstanding customer experience for their clients at every touchpoint. We expertly manage the mundane but necessary tasks so that our residents can focus on their passions - With us, they are not just renting space; they’re partnering for success.


Who are our residents:

In Core Collective lingo, our customers are called Residents. Personal Trainers, Chiropractors, Pilates instructors, physiotherapists, etc., are a few examples of our residents who comprise the community of health and wellness professionals.


Your impact:

As Core Collective grows we are looking for a Customer Experience Executive to join the team.

The CX team is the familiar face that all Residents and Members can look to when they have questions or issues. They are the "knowledge and call center" of the business. It is important that each and every single CX team member knows what is going on in the business in order to give accurate answers or to point Residents or Members in the accurate direction. They are the face of welcome and also the face of discipline.


What You’ll Be Doing:

Customer Service (Residents and Clients):

  • Ensure that customer experience excellence is delivered within the business, culture and values
  • Front desk duties and shift work, to greet and welcome guests, answering phone calls and perform service calls
  • Attend to both residents and clients request and resolve dispute in a timely manner
  • Assist in check ins with residents and clients in a systematic and timely manner
  • Assist in touring of space, and promote the brand / company’s services offered
  • Be trained with ability to close walk in leads
  • Follow through of SOPs at all times


Facilities and Operations:

title: ATE Test Engineer (Senior Test Engineer / Test Lead / Sr Test Lead)
description:
About Us:

Tessolve is a leading global semiconductor engineering service provider offering end-to-end silicon-to-system solutions across IC design, test and product engineering, PCB hardware design, failure analysis, and embedded systems. Backed by a global workforce of over 3,000 engineers across Taiwan, Singapore, Malaysia, India, the US, and Europe, we collaborate closely with the world's premier semiconductor companies to bring next-generation chips from concept to high-volume production.


Position: ATE Test Engineer / Senior Test Engineer / Test Lead / Sr Test Lead

(Designation and the compensation varies depending on the relevant experience)


Location: Taipei and Zhubei City, Taiwan (Candidates must be willing to work across both locations)


Position Overview:

We are seeking a highly experienced ATE Test Hardware Engineer to drive test hardware bring-up, debug, and correlation activities in a high-volume manufacturing environment. The candidate will play a critical role in ensuring robust test hardware performance, production stability, and yield optimization across wafer sort and final test.


Key Responsibilities:

Test Hardware Bring-Up & Qualification:

  • Lead load board and probe card bring-up new products on the Advantest V93K platform and Teradyne Ultraflex. Perform hardware checkout, validation, and debugging during initial silicon bring-up.
  • Drive Gage R&R (GR&R), stability, and repeatability qualification prior to production release.
  • Partner closely with design and Test Engineering teams during the NPI to HVM transition.

Debug & Failure Analysis:

  • Troubleshoot production failures associated with test hardware, test interfaces, and signal integrity. Conduct bench-to-ATE correlation and root cause analysis utilizing lab equipment (Oscilloscopes, DMMs, thermal tools).
  • Identify and resolve issues concerning sockets, load boards, pogo pins, probe cards, and contact failures. Support RMA, yield excursions, and lot-on-hold analyses.

Correlation & Production Release:

  • Own ATE-to-ATE, ATE-to-bench, and load board-to-load board correlation.
  • Drive correlation reports and acceptance criteria to ensure production readiness.
  • Validate test limits, guard bands, and parametric consistency across multiple manufacturing sites. Oversee smooth hardware releases to OSAT and production facilities.

Production Support & Yield Improvement:

  • Monitor hardware-related yield issues and drive robust root cause and corrective actions (RCCA). Perform failure trend analysis, bin analysis, and contact yield troubleshooting.
  • Support test time reduction (TTR) and throughput optimization initiatives.
  • Collaborate with product engineering for continuous yield enhancement aligned with correlation and production analytics.

Test Hardware Design & Optimization:

  • Review and support schematic design, physical layout, and signal integrity (SI) considerations for load boards.
  • Optimize site configurations, signal integrity, power distribution, and thermal performance. Drive multi-site scalability and overall cost optimization of hardware solutions.

Cross-Functional Leadership:

  • Lead technical interactions across Test Engineering (TE), Product Engineering (PE), Failure Analysis (FA), and OSAT / manufacturing teams.
  • Mentor junior engineers and champion Best Known Methods (BKM) for hardware debug and correlation. Manage project timelines, mitigate risks, and maintain clear stakeholder communication.


Requirements & Qualifications:

  • Nationality / Status: Taiwan Resident
  • Work Schedule: 5 days a week
  • Education: Bachelor’s or master’s degree in electrical or Electronics Engineering.
  • Experience: 2-12 years of relevant experience in semiconductor test engineering.


Technical Expertise:

  • Hands-on experience with Advantest V93K (SmarTest 7/8), load board/probe card bring-up, and debug.
  • Strong background in Wafer Sort & Final Test high-volume manufacturing (HVM), silicon bring-up, characterization, and correlation.
  • Solid grasp of signal integrity, power delivery, analog/digital measurements, and ATE instrumentation (DPS, AVI, PPMU, HSIO).


Preferred Skills:

  • Exposure to Teradyne UltraFlex, test program architecture, and JEDEC/AEC qualification/reliability testing.
  • Proficiency in yield/data analysis tools (JMP, Exensio, or Excel) and experience working with global teams and OSAT partners.

title: Government Information Specialist (Senior Disclosure Analyst)
description:
WHAT IS PRIVACY (PRVCY)? A description of the business units can be found at: https://www.jobs.irs.gov/about/who/business-divisions Position(s) are to be filled in following area(s): PRVCY - Data Overs and Records This job (or announcement) is open to current permanent IRS competitive service employees in Privacy business units. REVIEW THE ADDITIONAL INFORMATION BELOW FOR FURTHER DETAILS

The following are the duties of this position at the full working level. If this vacancy includes more than one grade and you are selected at a lower grade level, you will have the opportunity to learn to perform these duties and receive training to help you grow in this position. Serves as an expert advisor who provides technical and administrative guidance on highly complex Disclosure/privacy issues, including memorandums issued, Internal Revenue Manuals (IRMs), Treasury Inspector General for Tax Administration (TIGTA) reports and technology. Also, collaborates on and implements confidentiality-related policies for nationwide application to both internal and external customers. Reviews and analyzes appeals for denials of access to records requested under FOIA to identify trends and to make recommendations on releasing records for future requests. May be called upon to testify on behalf of the agency with regards to FOIA cases and assist Government attorneys in the litigation process. Develops IRS strategy and oversight procedures with regards to the administration of FOIA. Designs new approaches within the statutory and regulatory framework for problem solving where established methods and procedures are inapplicable, unavailable or inappropriate. Takes responsibility and stays focused on the issue until an effective policy decision is affected. Adapts to new information, changing conditions, or unexpected obstacles to effectively deal with ambiguity. Evaluates confidential personnel records that, if released, would constitute an unwarranted invasion of personal privacy. Evaluates the impact of the Privacy Act and regulations on the organization's activities. Also, coordinates with internal organizations, such as the agency's information technology security office. Represents the Internal Revenue Service (IRS) on issues related to the Privacy Act and other information privacy requirements. Assesses privacy risks associated with programs, operations, and technology. STANDARD POSITION DESCRIPTIONS (SPD): PD27044 Visit the IRS SPD Library to access the position descriptions.

Probationary Period - A person who is required to go through a probationary period and then is transferred, promoted, demoted, or reassigned before he or she completes such period is required to complete the remainder of the probationary period in the new position. Government Credit Card - Obtain and use a Government-issued charge card for business-related travel. ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS SHOWN IN QUALIFICATIONS SECTION

title: Senior Software Developer
description:

title: Hybrid Network Security Engineer – Enterprise & Multi-Site
description:
Tirlán is seeking a Network Security Engineer to safeguard and optimise our multi-site network across Kilkenny and Dublin. You will deploy, monitor and improve security controls, work with managed service partners, and support infrastructure projects in a large enterprise environment.

This role blends hands-on networking with security operations, offering hybrid working arrangements, collaboration across IT teams, and ongoing opportunities to contribute to IT transformation initiatives within a

Partner with managed service providers to support and continuously improve Tirlán's network and security environments. Configure, deploy and maintain enterprise networking equipment, including switches, routers, wireless technologies and firewalls. Implement and maintain network security controls in line with guidance from the Information Security team. Monitor network performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve availability, reliability and resilience. Support network capacity planning, upgrades, expansions and technology refresh programmes. Troubleshoot and resolve network and firewall incidents, service disruptions and performance issues. Contribute to disaster recovery, business continuity and resilience planning activities. Maintain accurate network topology diagrams, configurations and technical documentation. Ensure compliance with relevant security standards, policies and best practices. Collaborate with infrastructure, cybersecurity and application teams to support new business initiatives and projects. Provide technical expertise and recommendations to support the ongoing evolution of Tirlán's network infrastructure. Contribute to the development and delivery of Tirlán's enterprise infrastructure strategy. Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience. Experience supporting enterprise-scale network environments. Strong understanding of WAN, LAN, WLAN, routing, switching, firewalls, VPNs and remote access technologies. Experience configuring and supporting network infrastructure in complex multi-site environments. Knowledge of network security principles and best practices. Experience managing and collaborating with third-party service providers. Strong troubleshooting, analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities. Hybrid working Health and wellbeing supports On-site gym Free parking Career development opportunities

The role focuses on robust software design, algorithm development in digital imaging, and collaboration across disciplines to move products forward in a fast-evolving environment.

Work across the full development spectrum from research to product-ready implementation. Contribute to feature development using C++, C#, and Python. title: Fish and Wildlife Administrator
description:
You will serve as a Fish and Wildlife Administrator with the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service, Hawaii and Pacific Islands National Wildlife Refuge Complex in Honolulu, Hawaii. Cost of Living Allowance (COLA) rate of 8.64% is authorized.

Some of the major duties you will perform include but are not limited to the following: Providing leadership and direction to ensure appropriate coordination, strategic planning, budget and performance integration, and accomplishment reporting. Preparing briefing statements, issue papers, status reports, Congressional testimony, responses to oral and written inquiries, and other documents and materials on program policy, planning, and management activities in a manner that communicates this material for a diverse set of audiences. Serving as an expert consultant and provides authoritative advice to senior management and other Service officials and managers concerning controversial and complex scientific, political, and economic issues. Providing technical assistance and expertise to appropriate offices, including the promotion of each program, consideration of these programs in multiple strategies, staffing, potential partnerships, economic activities, and restoration planning. Performing a full range of supervisory/managerial duties and responsibilities over the assigned staff and organizational elements. Representing the Service and/or the Department on task forces, committees, working groups and other special programs and details and is knowledgeable and skilled in relaying information on Program policy and planning, management, and restoration activities.

Must be a U.S. Citizen or National. Appointment subject to background investigation and favorable adjudication. Males born after 12-31-59 must be registered for Selective Service. Direct Deposit participation required. Successfully pass the E-Verify employment verification check. To learn more, visit https://www.e-verify.gov/. A financial disclosure report will be required within 30 days of appointment. As a condition of employment for accepting this position, you may be required to serve a 1 year probationary period to evaluate your fitness and whether your continuation of employment advances the public interest. This probationary period is an extension of the appointment process and therefore requires the agency to determine if continued employment would advance the public interest, meet the organization goals and mission of the agency, and/or otherwise promote the efficiency of the service. In determining if your employment advances the public interest, the agency will consider: your performance and conduct; the needs and interests of the agency; whether your continued employment would advance organizational goals of the agency or the Government; and whether your continued employment would advance the efficiency of the Federal service. Under applicable law, the employment of an individual serving a probationary or trial period automatically terminates when that period ends unless the agency affirmatively certifies, in writing, that the individual's employment should continue and that their appointment should be finalized. In the absence of agency action to affirmatively certify continued employment beyond the probationary or trial period, such appointments are terminated. Upon completion of your probationary your employment will be terminated unless you receive certification, in writing, that your continued employment advances the public interest. This is a supervisory position that may require completion of a supervisory probationary period.

title: Data Scientist
description:

title: Director, Office of Scientific and Technical Information
description:
The Department of Energy's (DOE) Office of Science has a mission to deliver scientific discoveries and major scientific tools to transform our understanding of nature and advance the energy, economic, and national security of the United States. Office of Science is the nation's largest federal sponsor of basic research in the physical sciences and are a major supporter of research in such key scientific fields as physics, materials science, computing, and chemistry.

As the Director, Office of Scientific and Technical Information, you will: Oversee the full range of operational functions to support SC efforts in managing policy and planning, general support, and direction for the Scientific and Technical Information Program mission. Manage and administer systems and information technology tools for the collection, announcement, dissemination, and historical reference to scientific and technical information resulting from DOE's research and development efforts and from energy research development efforts of other industrialized countries. Manage the Department's centralized scientific and technical information facility. Negotiate, execute, and administer agreements for the dissemination of DOE scientific and technical information products by statutorily-established dissemination outlets; assists in the development, coordination, and administration of agreements and international information consortiums with other countries for the exchange of scientific and technical information. Develop and manage technical information support activities, including, but not limited to, a computerized system that lists and describes approved ongoing research and development projects and a consortium purchasing agreement.

Must be a U.S. Citizen or National. Subject to a 1-year SES probationary period (unless already completed). Complete a Declaration for Federal Employment to determine your suitability for Federal employment, at the time requested by the agency. If you are a male applicant born after December 31, 1959, certify that you have registered with the Selective Service System or are exempt from having to do so. May be subject to pre-employment and random drug tests. File a Confidential Financial Disclosure Report OGE-278 within 30 days of appointment and annually from then on. You may be required to obtain and maintain an interim and/or final security clearance prior to entrance on duty. Failure to obtain and maintain the required level of clearance may result in the withdrawal of a job offer or removal. There are three key documents that contain important information about your rights and obligations. Please read and retain these documents: Noncriminal Justice Applicant's Privacy Rights, for those who undergo an FBI fingerprint-based criminal history record check for personnel vetting, which includes Rap Back, FD-258 Privacy Act Statement - FBI (this is the same statement used when your fingerprints are submitted as part of your background investigation), and SEAD-3-Reporting-U.pdf (dni.gov), (applicable to those who hold a sensitive position or have eligibility for access to classified information)

title: System Developer
description:
Are you a System Developer who enjoys turning business needs into smart, reliable solutions? At FM Mattsson, you’ll work closely with teams across the organisation to develop and improve business-critical systems, with a particular focus on our ERP platform, Infor M3.


The role
Digitalisation plays an important role in how FM Mattsson continues to evolve. Our systems and digital solutions are designed to support our operations and help us work more efficiently. As a System Developer, you will join our Digitalisation team and collaborate with teams across the organisation to turn business needs and ideas into effective technical solutions. Your role will span development, integrations and problem-solving, with a particular focus on our ERP system, M3.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop, customise and maintain internal applications and solutions within M3 and our wider system landscape.
  • Develop and maintain integrations between M3 and other systems.
  • Design technical solutions and help establish shared technical standards and best practices.
  • Develop, test and quality-assure solutions, as well as troubleshoot complex technical issues.
  • Contribute to and lead development and digitalisation initiatives.
  • Collaborate with teams across the organisation, internal specialists and external partners, and coordinate external M3 consultants when needed.
  • Help improve processes and ways of working across the organisation.

What we’re looking for
We’re looking for someone who enjoys using technology to solve real business challenges and is eager to understand what users and the organisation actually need. You are curious, pragmatic and comfortable working both independently and as part of a team. As you’ll work with people across different parts of the organisation, strong communication and collaboration skills are important.

We’re looking for someone with:

  • A university degree in software development, systems design or a related field.
  • Experience in software development and programming, preferably with Java, JavaScript and Angular or similar technologies.
  • Experience working with ERP systems or other business-critical systems.
  • A good understanding of databases, integrations and system architecture.
  • The ability to understand business needs and turn them into effective technical solutions.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, as well as Swedish if based in Sweden or Danish if based in Denmark.

It is an advantage if you also have experience in:

  • Infor M3.
  • Integrations and automation.
  • The manufacturing industry.
  • AI-assisted software development or the use of AI tools in development.

Practical details
Start date: As soon as possible / by agreement
Employment type: Permanent position
Location: Mora, Sweden, or Odense, Denmark
Hiring Manager: Head of Digitalisation Benny Skoog (benny.skoog@fmmattssongroup.com)
Union representative (Unionen): Claes Frisk (+46 70 375 60 34)
Relocation support in Mora: Through Rekryteringslots Dalarna, we can offer support for accompanying partners relocating to the area. Read more at www.rekryteringslots.se
Application deadline: 29 November

About FM Mattsson Group
FM Mattsson Group develops, manufactures and sells taps and related products under the well-established brands FM Mattsson, Mora Armatur, Damixa, Hotbath, Aqualla and Bristan. Our vision is to be our customers’ first choice for bathrooms, kitchens and related areas. Our core values guide how we work together and how we engage with the world around us:

  • The customer comes first
  • We win together
  • I step forward

In 2025, FM Mattsson Group generated revenue of approximately SEK 2.0 billion and employed around 560 people across Sweden, Norway, Denmark, Finland, the Benelux region, the UK, Germany and Italy. In 2026, the Group acquired Bristan Group in the UK, which had approximately 280 employees at the time of the acquisition. FM Mattsson AB (publ) is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm.

How to apply
Does this sound like the right opportunity for you? Click “Apply” to submit your application. We conduct interviews on an ongoing basis, and the position may be filled before the application deadline, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible. The application deadline is 29 November.

We look forward to receiving your application!

Plans and executes a variety of complex internal and external special events, including VISN-wide and national events where the local facility is a key host or sponsor, or responsible for securing major monetary or in-kind donations and volunteer support. Performs other duties as assigned. Promotion Potential: The selectee may be promoted to the full performance level without further competition when all regulatory, qualification, and performance requirements are met. Selection at a lower grade level does not guarantee promotion to the full performance level. Work Schedule: Monday thru Friday, 7:00am - 3:30pm. Compressed/Flexible: Not Authorized. Telework: Not Authorized. Virtual: This is not a virtual position. This is done in the context of healing relationships and healing environments and a connection back to the Veteran's community. This aligns with the Veterans Health Administration (VHA) Mission Statement to Honor America's Veterans by providing exceptional health care that improves their health and well-being.

title: Associate Manager, Pricing Optimization (Bangkok-based, relocation provided)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

The team

Agoda's Marketing team operates at the intersection of business strategy, data, and execution. We build and scale programs across growth, pricing, and commercial initiatives that drive customer value and sustainable business performance globally. We're analytical, fast-moving, and deeply cross-functional - partnering closely with Product, Finance, Corporate Strategy, and Supply to shape Agoda's growth agenda.

About the role

In this role, you will shape pricing and commercial strategies for partner opportunities, advise stakeholders on trade-offs, and drive value through execution and experimentation. You will work across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Marketing, and partner-facing teams, often in situations where alignment matters as much as the analysis itself.

What you'll do

  • Own and evolve pricing strategies and optimization for Agoda.
  • Build and lead experimentation roadmaps, including test design, success measures, decision frameworks, and post-test actions.
  • Evaluate pricing and growth opportunities through structured analysis, including elasticity, incrementality, cannibalization, and scenario modeling where relevant.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to senior internal and external stakeholders; surface trade-offs, align priorities, and drive decisions to closure; Coordinate cross-functional execution across Commercial, Product, Data Science, Marketing, and operations teams.
  • Turn complex findings into concise executive narratives, recommendations, and decision-ready materials;
  • Manage strategic partner and vendor interactions when required, including presentations, working sessions, and follow-ups.


What you'll bring

  • Experience applying quantitative analysis to commercial decisions in technology, e-commerce, travel, management consulting, internal strategy, or pricing.
  • Strong business judgment and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to frame ambiguous questions, evaluate trade-offs, and recommend a path forward.
  • Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills, including the ability to influence without authority and build alignment across functions, seniority levels, and geographies.
  • Fluency with data and analytical tools, including advanced SQL; experience with visualization tools such as Tableau or an equivalent platform.
  • Practical experience designing or interpreting controlled experiments and translating results into decisions.
  • A high-ownership, bias-for-action mindset and comfort operating in a fast-paced, test-and-learn environment.
  • A bachelor's degree in a quantitative, business, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.


It's a plus if you have

  • A background in using quantitative data for decision making within tech, ecommerce , management consulting, internal strategy, or pricing initiatives
  • Experience building decision frameworks or analytical tools that are used repeatedly in live business decisions.
  • Working knowledge of Python or R for modeling and scalable analysis.


What success looks like

  • Become a trusted advisor whose recommendations are clear, rigorous, and commercially grounded.
  • Turn pricing insights and experiments into decisions and coordinated execution.
  • Build alignment across stakeholders, functions, and markets.
  • Develop repeatable approaches that can scale across partners.

title: Data Engineer
description:

title: Sr PM, Returns Experience MX, LATAM CFX
description:
The Amazon Mexico team is looking for a talented, smart, and entrepreneurial Sr Product Manager to help us lead highly complex, high-impact initiatives that shape how millions of customers receive and return their orders.

This is a high-visibility role with leadership-level exposure. You will define and deliver products that require deep technical acumen, customer obsession, data analytics, strong business judgment, and an ability to work across a broad range of stakeholders including WW and Local program management, product management, business intelligence engineering, software engineering, category, legal, operations, taxes, machine learning, supply chain, and finance teams.

We are looking for a leader with super-powers in customer experience, analytics, and getting things done (a not-that-frequent combination!). S/he should be a self-starter that thrives in ambiguity, with the ability to influence multi-functionally, and the willingness to roll up sleeves to execute in a dynamic environment.

As a Returns Experience Sr Product Manager you will lead channel-agnostic initiatives to solve for customer experience pain-points across their post-purchase and returns journey in Mexico.

Your initiatives will shape strategy, drive customer satisfaction, and drive business growth and profitability across one of Amazon's most critical areas.

The role focuses on identifying opportunities and gaps in our post-purchase & returns experience which may include opportunities in our concessions & returns policies, returns resolutions, product lifecycle support (PLS), catalog and fulfillment, channel parity gaps, operating procedures, product/program's logic, etc. While designing, developing and executing a comprehensive master plan with strategic initiatives to improve the way we serve our customers.

A successful candidate will develop a strong understanding of our business, customers and implement data-driven solutions with direct impact in customers and Amazon's growth.

Key job responsibilities
Strategic Solutions Development and Launch:
Drive customer-centric innovation, using data to deeply understand pain points and craft scalable solutions. You follow Amazon product development best practices and work backwards to identify gaps and defects in customers shopping and post-purchase journey. You make use of business & customer research and quantitative analysis. You identify emerging use cases and clarify how they differ from existing solutions. You are data-driven and understand the risk of action. You understand a broad range of analytics techniques and know when to use them.

Program and Product Management:
Own the end-to-end product strategy, roadmap, and execution for key components of the Product Lifecycle Support (PLS) and Returns Experience (RCX).
Owning the end-to-end launch of programs, features and initiatives to improve the Product Lifecycle Support (PLS) and Returns Experience (RCX) and manage product portfolio once launched. Align product vision with long-term business goals and influence cross-functional teams to deliver on that vision. Standardize processes across different business units, channels, and align recommended processes with stakeholders.

Continuous Improvement:
Own Returns experience and Product lifecycle support (PLS) at a process level. Define and monitor metrics, perform root cause analysis on defects and implement remediation; own continuous improvement strategy. Function as a main point of contact for escalations, coordinating multi-functionally to provide advice, implement solutions, and monitor resolutions.

About the team
Inclusive team culture

At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance

We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.
